⚠️ URGENT SECURITY NOTICE: Please Read


Yesterday, my account was compromised, and whoever gained access posted a fake job opening and reached out to several of you via DM asking for personal information and bank details.
If you received any suspicious messages or job offers from me in the last 24 hours Please do not share any details.
If you already sent your bank or personal info Please delete those messages immediately and contact your bank right away just to be safe.
Do not click on any links that were sent from my profile during that time.
I have safely recovered my account and changed all security settings. I am going through my inbox now to message everyone affected directly, but wanted to post this here first to get the word out as quickly as possible.
I am genuinely sorry for the hassle, confusion, or worry this caused anyone. Thank you so much for your patience and understanding.
